description.en: Russian (Русский) language pack for the DSH Web UI: 33 namespaces, 1061 strings (100% coverage) registered through the official dsh-client-locale plugin API; also localizes permission preset display names via a config layer.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面的俄语语言包：通过官方 dsh-client-locale 插件 API 注册 33 个命名空间、1061 条界面字符串（100% 覆盖）；并通过配置层本地化权限预设显示名。
